day_local: Khamiista Toddobaadka 27-aad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'albaabka la garaacayo'. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheeko ku saabsan nin saaxiibkiis u yimid habeenkii, isagoo garaacaya albaabka si uu u helo saddex rooti. 'Garaaca, albaabkana waa laydinka furi doonaa,' ayuu yiri Rabbigu. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil garaacay albaabbo badan oo aqoon iyo naxariis ah. Xusuusnow sida uu ugu riyoon jiray 'Con Chim Airlines', isagoo dhisaya barnaamijyadiisa, isagoo eegaya dunida indho waasac ah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil albaabka nolosha ka galay si geesinimo leh, isagoo garanaya inuu Ilaahay albaabka u hayo.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo ay xusuustaadu kusoo dhacdo dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Xusuusnow, xataa markii uu 15 sano jir ahaa, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi saafi ah oo rabay inuu u huro wax walba uu haysto si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka aad koriseen, waana midda Ilaah uu ku farxo.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu ku qaylinayaa: 'O, Galatiyada doqonnada ah! ... Miyaydnaan ku bilaabin Ruuxa, oo aad hadda ku dhammaynaysaan jidhka?' Ben wuxuu ku bilaabay Ruuxa. Wuxuu ku noolaa jacayl saafi ah. Markii uu ku jiray safarradiisii, laga bilaabo Lourdes ilaa Vatican-ka, wuxuu bartay inuu gacantiisa u dhiibo Ilaah. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu gacantiisa ku jiraa gacanta Aabbaha. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Waxaad weydiisateen rooti, Ilaahna wuxuu idin siiyay Ruuxa Quduuska ah oo ku jira Ben, oo hadda ku nasta xaggiisa.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Haddaad albaabka garaacdeen, ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad joogto Sakramenti Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata, fadlan qalbigayga ku kaalay xagga ruuxa. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sida adigoo horey ii joogay, waxaana isu dhiibayaa adiga gebi ahaanba. Ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbiga ha inoo barakeeyo, ha inoo ilaaliyo, oo ha inoo iftiimiyo wejigiisa. Nabadda Rabbiga ha inala jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: U ducee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii dhintay, si ay u nastaan iftiinka Masiixa.
U ducee dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, si uu Ilaah u qalbi qaboojiyo oo uu rajo u siiyo.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: O, Galatiyada doqonnada ah! Yaa idin sixray, kuwaas oo indhahooda hortooda Ciise Masiix loogu sawiray inuu iskutallaabta ku qallalay? Waxaan idinka rabaa inaan tan oo keliya ogaado: Ruuxa ma ku hesheen shuqullada sharciga, mise rumaysadka waxa aad maqasheen? Miyaydnaan doqon ahayn? Ma waxaad Ruuxa ku billowdeen, oo aad hadda ku dhammaynaysaan jidhka? Waxyaalo badan miyaad si aan micno lahayn u soo martay?–hadday run ahaanba aan micno lahayn ahayd. Haddaba kan Ruuxa idin siiya, oo shuqullo waaweyn dhexdiinna ku sameeya, ma shuqullada sharciga buu ku sameeyaa mise rumaysadka waxa aad maqasheen?

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa. Wuxuu inoo sara kiciyey badbaadiye xoog leh, oo ka dhashay reerkii addoonkiisii Daa'uud. R. Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa. Sida uu afka nebiyadiisa quduuska ah ugu ballanqaaday tan iyo wakhti hore, inuu inaga badbaadin doono cadowgeenna, iyo gacanta dhammaan kuwa inala neceb. R. Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa. Wuxuu ballanqaaday inuu awoowyaasheen u naxariisan doono, oo uu xusuusan doono axdigiisa quduuska ah. R. Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa. Tani waxay ahayd dhaartii uu u dhaartay aabbahayagii Ibraahim: inuu gacanta cadowgeenna inaga xoreeyo, oo aynu isaga u caabudno cabsi la'aan, quduusnimo iyo xaqnimo hortiisa, maalmaha nolosheenna oo dhan. R. Rabbiga, Ilaaha reer binu Israa'iil, ha lagu ammaano; wuxuu u yimid dadkiisa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi: 'Bal qiyaasa midkiin oo saaxiib leh, oo u taga saqdii dhexe oo ku yidhaahda, "Saaxiibow, saddex rooti ii amaahi, waayo saaxiibkay baa safar iga yimid, oo wax aan u dhigo ma hayo," oo kii gudaha joogayna uu ugu jawaabo, "Ha i dhibin; albaabkii waa la xidhay, oo aniga iyo carruurtaydu sariirta ayaannu ku jirnaa. Ma kici karo inaan wax ku siiyo." Waxaan idin leeyahay, hadduusan u kicin inuu wax siiyo saaxiibtinimadooda aawadeed, wuu u kici doonaa inuu siiyo wax kasta oo uu u baahan yahay dadaalkiisa aawadiis. Oo waxaan idin leeyahay, weydiista, waana laydin siin doonaa; raadiya, waana heli doontaan; garaaca, albaabkana waa laydinka furi doonaa. Waayo qof kasta oo weydiista, wuu helaa; kii raadiyana, wuu helaa; kii garaacana, albaabka waa laga furaa. Aabbe kee baa idin ka mid ah oo wiilkiisu kalluun weydiisto, oo abeeso siinaya? Mise hadduu ukun weydiisto, abeeso siinaya? Haddaba haddii idinka oo shar leh, aad tihiin kuwo garanaya inay carruurtiinna hadiyado wanaagsan siiyaan, intee in leeg ayuu Aabbaha jannada ku jiraa siin doonaa Ruuxa Quduuska ah kuwa isaga weydiista?'

day: Thursday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
